reasonForOfficialPeaks: The existing v560 oracle diagnostic has higher official-peak +/-5 ms output correctness than parabolic; both representations share the same detected peak indices
population: Only clear+approximate labels in sample-032/sample-002; report all and E10-incorrect subsets with population weights
categoriesInPriorityOrder: correctPeakSelectedByOldTarget: nearest official peak to actual is within 5 ms and exactly equals the old target-selected official peak
correctPeakReachableButNotSelected: nearest official peak to actual is within 5 ms and inside old target +/-10 ms, but another peak was selected
correctPeakOutsideOldTargetWindow: nearest official peak to actual is within 5 ms but outside old target +/-10 ms
nearbyPeakButOutside5ms: nearest official peak within 20 ms exists but is more than 5 ms from actual
noOfficialPeakWithin20ms: no official peak within actual +/-20 ms
nearestRule: Nearest peak to annotated actual within +/-20 ms using searchsorted and positions position-1/position/position+1; ties by smaller absolute distance then smaller peak time
oracleBounds: Add only E10-incorrect weight in correctPeakOutsideOldTargetWindow to current overall correct weight
Add E10-incorrect weight in all three correct-peak categories to current overall correct weight
Both are label-centered upper bounds, not deployable candidates or measured system improvements

hypotheses.H1: Correct peaks outside the old target window account for at least 20% of E10-incorrect audible weight in sample-032/sample-002
hypotheses.H2: Recovering only E10-incorrect outside-window correct peaks cannot raise the three-song overall audible correct rate to 80%
hypotheses.H3: Every row is assigned exactly one category and all counts, weights and bounds can be independently reconstructed from frozen activations, targets and labels

testPolicy: Diagnostic only; no threshold sweep, target correction, candidate generation, new inference, production code change or confirmation-set access
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
